messages:
Ana: quick sync: we need a tiny launch postcard + webinar hook focused on latency vs cost. 3 visuals max. goal: dev signups + enterprise demo leads.

Rex: headline idea: 'Predictable latency. Clearer bills.' keep it < 40 chars.

Jo: charts: 1) scatter: cost per 1k tokens vs median latency (hosted vs dedicated), 2) bar: batching impact (tokens saved), 3) line: p99 tail before/after cache. each with 1-line takeaway.

Liam: routing: corporate domains -> demo booking form (capture company size), personal -> sandbox. UTMs for variant A/B.

Ana: copy: opener "Tired of surprise inference bills?" blurb: "We ran mixed workloads and found batching + cache cuts token spend 2-4x without increasing tail latency." CTA buttons: "Try sandbox (5 min)" and "Book demo (20 min)"

Rex: ask eng for hosted vs dedicated csv + 4-bit quantized row. need numbers by Tue EOD.

Jo: design: PNGs + 4s GIF for batching. mobile-first layout.

marketing-bot: Campaign drafted (id: camp_8001). Drive: https://drive.redwood/bench-postcard-8001.

Ana: timeline: draft Wed, design Thu, QA Fri, send next Tue. tagging @Liam for forms.

Liam: stubbed HubSpot forms and will add ids when ready.

Ana: keep claims conservative, get legal signoff for any customer quote. thanks — drop numbers when they arrive. :rocket:
